create_OSS_optimizer: create an OSS optimizer wrapping Adam to shard optimizer state across distributed ranks
run_OSS_step: run a single optimization step on the sharded OSS optimizer and broadcast updated parameters
clip_OSS_grad_norm: clip the gradient norm across all OSS optimizer shards using all-reduce synchronization
consolidate_OSS_state_dict: consolidate the sharded optimizer state dict from all ranks into a single global state
refresh_OSS_trainable: refresh the OSS optimizer partitioning when parameter trainability changes during training
